scope: Public textual factual research and first-party procedural authoring; no vehicle/source art copied

sourceFactsReceipt.owner: Root; copied assertions independently checked against the two public pages

sources.facts: Circular automatic conveyor carries 22 separate projectile/propellant sets; 22 additional nonmechanized reserve sets. Family evidence corroborates mechanism and capacity, not all A-variant calibration.

page80_BK14.construction: single HEAT warhead plus separate 4Zh40/4Zh52 charge

sources.limits: Guide identifies rounds found in Ukraine, not a measured 1979 tank ammunition mix or a complete exterior ballistics calibration. The PDF remains in ignored target research storage.

fieldProvenance.vehicle.hull.size_m[0,2]: Published width over skirts and hull length. Hull collision width uses the over-skirt envelope; closed hull visual body is narrower.
fieldProvenance.vehicle.hull.size_m[1],turret,center_of_: Engineering reconstruction of hull/turret split, center of mass and contours; ring 2.16 m is a nominal estimate here.
fieldProvenance.visual.parts: First-party primitive/loft construction from textual proportions. Six 750 mm road wheels, station spacing, rollers, cast turret sections, hatch/optics/light placements and gun sleeves are estimated, not traced source measurements.
fieldProvenance.weapons.main_gun.caliber_mm,id,elevation: Variant identity and limits from Weaponsystems.
fieldProvenance.weapons.main_gun.barrel_length_mm,recoil: Engineering estimates for runtime movement and geometry.
fieldProvenance.weapons.mechanized_loading.capacity: 22 total mechanized sets including the initial chambered set, preserving the existing stock accounting convention; no second carousel quantity counter.
fieldProvenance.weapons.main_gun.ammo_count: Authored deployment mix 8 APFSDS / 6 HEAT / 8 HE-FRAG, not a historical prescribed load.
fieldProvenance.weapons.mechanized_loading.cycle_s: 8 s is an authored base choice within reported 7-8 rpm. Carousel selection distance, service condition and loading elevation are not explicitly simulated.
fieldProvenance.weapons.mechanized_loading.stages: select_lift 0, projectile_ram .32, charge_ram .61 are provisional consumed-work presentation milestones. Separate two-piece handling is documented; exact stage cadence is not.
fieldProvenance.weapons.sight: TPD-K1 laser identity documented; magnification/FOV, error and range limits remain estimates. The existing laser owner supplies its gameplay measurement timing.
fieldProvenance.engine: 780 hp/2000 rpm and 3089 Nm/1400 rpm documented; other curve points, weight, ratios, final drive, shifting and suspension constants estimated. Positive min_turn_radius_m=1.51 is a conservative half-gauge runtime estimate to avoid granting zero-radius counter-rotation. Existing JS/Rust continuous track-difference and creeping turn owner does not reproduce the requested one-moving/one-stopped planetary pivot. The source table word Pivot does not establish neutral steering. No claim that steering or top speed is fully historically calibrated.
fieldProvenance.armor: Scalar RHA adapter only: 200 mm hull upper, 80 mm lower/sides, 45 rear, 30 roofs, 20 floor; 280 mm turret front,120 sides,65 rear,200 mantlet are explicit gameplay engineering estimates. Real welded hull/cast laminate turret, obliquity, layer equivalence and exact surface geometry are not reproduced. No later applique or ERA.
fieldProvenance.crew,modules: Correct three-crew/no-loader roles; sphere/box positions, health and repair values estimated. AZ drive/ram use existing horizontal/vertical drive module kinds solely as named physical-damage adapters; explicit weapon laying refs exclude them from traverse/elevation.
fieldProvenance.projectiles.apfsds_125_3bm22: Nominal compatible 3BM-22 reconstruction: 44 mm flight body,4.83 kg,1760 m/s,453 mm length are currently unverified engineering estimates. Homogenized steel ignores its mixed tip composition. Penetration420/385/350/315 mm at0/1/2/3 km,drag.3,ricochet78 and no shatter are estimates. No modern-round or Panther identity reused.
fieldProvenance.projectiles.heatfs_125_3bk14: GICHD sourced mass19.02 kg,explosive1.85 kg OKFOL,length677 mm; velocity905 m/s and flat450 mm penetration,drag.3,ricochet80,instant impact fuse are estimates.
fieldProvenance.projectiles.he_125_3of26: GICHD sourced mass23.2 kg,explosive3.34 kg A-IX-2,length675 mm,velocity850 m/s; flat35 mm penetration,drag.3,ricochet85 and instant impact fuse are engineering adapters.
fieldProvenance.machine_guns.pkt,nsvt: New documented PKT/NSVT identities. Compatible cartridge ballistics, heat and reload estimates reuse SGMT/DShK catalog metrics; cyclic800/700 rpm are estimates. Rendered geometry is generic first-party geometry and damage_geometry is measured from that exact renderer, not authentic weapon art.
fieldProvenance.audio: User-adopted generic drive,ram,lock textures interpreted for AZ; normal pitch, ram twice, actual-ready lock. No authentic AZ recording claim. Audio owner remains a separate Root integration step.

authorityBoundary: Existing g.ammo/OnlineAmmo/C2AmmoLedger exclusively owns quantity and scope. Mechanism owns reload work/readiness/cycle. Existing server has no conventional cannon reload clock; this implementation does not claim new server cadence authority.
